name: Faithful Balancepoint
description: The user stands in the court's stance with the hatchet at the hip and the free hand open before the chest.

name: Vigor Spikepoll
description: The court's first chop falls from the high guard onto the opponent's lead shoulder.

name: Spinning Toss
description: A short toss from the court draw turns once and lands bit-first at five paces.

name: Imperial Hurl
description: A forward step and a cut are paired so the blade lands as the lead foot does.

name: Delugehead
description: The haft turns a descending blade out along the court's guard line.

name: Peerless Thumbnotch
description: The thrower marks one point on the target like a hawk fixing on prey and hits it.

name: Thunderclap Edgecurve
description: The beard hooks the weapon wrist and the user's pull drags it off the cutting line.

name: Seasonlob
description: Cut, step and throw follow in three beats, the third landing as the foe answers the first.

name: Heroic Fling
description: A fan of hatchets thrown from the court draw spreads across a doorway or lane and holds a group back.

name: Interstice Quickbit
description: A flash step covers the gap in a blink, and the chop lands before the guard is raised.

name: Seasonhurl
description: The school's culminating line: a hatchet thrown from the draw is followed along its path by the user's own cut, both landing together.

name: Headtroth
description: Two hatchets rest crossed at the chest like a hawk's folded wings.

name: Inferno Birchhelve
description: The lead hatchet strikes down with the beard forward like a raking talon.

name: Flingedict
description: One hatchet is tossed from the perched guard while its twin stays at the chest.

name: Squall Lob
description: A step with both arms flung wide opens the guard on purpose and draws the opponent in.

name: Vigorfling
description: After the first hatchet is parried, the second follows on the opposite side.

name: Entropy Pitch
description: Both beards hook the wrists and spread the arms, baring the chest.

name: Unrivaled Tailknob
description: Two hatchets are lobbed in a high pair over a raised shield onto the head behind it.

name: Deluge Lightbit
description: A hatchet flicked like a pinion feather catches a thrust and passes it to the other haft.

name: Destiny Thumbnotch
description: Two hatchets chase one target, one cutting high and one low, each answering the dodge of the other.

name: Sigillob
description: Two hatchets thrown on opposite arcs close on the target like a net and pin its sleeves and cloak.

name: Chuck Boon
description: The user vanishes in a flash step and drops from above with both hatchets already falling.

name: Peerless Thunderclap Throwhelve
description: The school's finishing descent: both hatchets fall together from the folded guard, one at the guard and one at the gap behind it.

name: Unwavering Tailknob
description: The user sits low in the legs like a basin floor so a heavy blow settles into the ground.

name: Bedrock Birchhelve
description: A chop with the grip slid to the haft's end reaches far, like a river overrunning its bank.

name: Thunderclap Lightbit
description: A low toss skims close above the ground like a stone skipping along a bank.

name: Pall Tomahead
description: The haft spins in a small circle like an eddy and wraps a blade out of line.

name: Chasing Tomahead
description: A running step follows the line of the foe's weak side like a current finding the shore.

name: Peal Balancepoint
description: A hard throw across a stream or ditch lands on a foe who thought the water protected him.

name: Tempestuous Spikepoll
description: Hatchets thrown in quick succession spread like flood water over a low field and sweep a group back.

name: Symphonic Quickbit
description: Throw, curve and cut follow the winding path of a river, each reaching the foe from a new side.

name: Wraithlike Toss
description: A flash step ends beside the foe and the hatchet leaves at point-blank before the step is seen.

name: Famed Hurl
description: The school's reach throw: the hatchet leaves along a bend like a river's, curving round cover to land where the foe thought himself hidden.

name: Throwhelve Troth
description: Two hatchets held wide and level guard the left and right of the body in the court's open guard.

name: Gallant Lob
description: The left hatchet and then the right cut down in measured turn across the same target.

name: Prismflint
description: Both hatchets are tossed a short way together, one above the other, to test the guard.

name: Thunderclap Pitch
description: One cut runs along each of the court's two tracks as the user steps through between them.

name: Subjugating Fling
description: One beard hooks the guard aside and the other hand throws through the opening.

name: Pall Spikepoll
description: The paired hafts stop a blow in a cross and spring apart in counter-cuts.

name: Nightmare Edgecurve
description: Both hatchets feint the same line in mirror, so the foe commits to a guard against the wrong hand.

name: Destiny Fling
description: A strike on each of the two tracks follows in sequence so a block on one opens the other.

name: Famed Chuck
description: Volleys thrown from left and right close on a group like the arms of a pincer.

name: Thunderclap Tomahead
description: The user flashes beside the foe and both hatchets fall on either side of the guard at once.

name: Thunderclap Thumbnotch
description: The school's double stroke: two verdict cuts on the two tracks fall together, one parried and one certain to land.

name: Enshrined Quickbit
description: The user holds a high, still perch with the hatchet drawn back and the eyes on the foe.

name: Steel Hurl
description: From a raised step the bit falls in a steep chop onto the crown of the guard.

name: Tranquil Tailknob
description: A glance at drifting dust or smoke gives the air's direction before the dive.

name: Bedrock Edgecurve
description: A long descending step down a slope or stair gathers speed for the stoop.

name: Dauntless Throwhelve
description: Thrown from a roof or rise, the hatchet falls at a steep angle onto the foe below.

name: Peremptory Lightbit
description: The beard rakes down the foe's guarding arm and drags it away from the face.

name: Pall Throwhelve
description: The user slips to the side on a wing-like turn and lets the haft slide a blade past.

name: Nightmare Toss
description: A dive that stops a pace short makes the foe commit to a block before the real cut.

name: Tenetflint
description: A stoop, a throw and a recovering step let the user dive and withdraw before the counter.

name: Headdecree
description: Axes thrown from a height fall across an open space in a sweeping descent.

name: Thunderclap Lob
description: The user flashes up and drops, the hatchet piercing the guard before the eye finds where they went.

name: Vacuum Spikepoll
description: The school's finishing fall: the user stoops from the perch and the axe drives through the guard, the whole body behind the blow.

name: Settled Quickbit
description: The user stands with the Core's weight settled low and the hatchet held as if the ground were the court's.

name: Quenched Lightbit
description: A chop backed by the Core's steady qi lands with a weight no arm alone could give.

name: Peal Pitch
description: Qi from the Core is fed into a short throw so the hatchet flies hard and unwavering.

name: Headpledge
description: The haft turns a heavy blow aside with an ease that shows the weight behind it.

name: Bedrock Chuck
description: A step driven from the Core carries the user two strides in one.

name: Squall Pitch
description: A throw along the horizon's line skims low and flat, far past the reach of an ordinary arm.

name: Fearless Fling
description: Axes thrown on Core qi cross a wide basin or yard in one sweep and pin a force beyond it.

name: Volition Birchhelve
description: Throw, step and cut follow one line, the Core's qi joining all three without a break.

name: Radiance Hurl
description: A flash of Core qi puts the user at the foe's side with the hatchet already falling.

name: Symphonic Tenet Tomahead
description: The school's highest line: throw, flash and cut share one unbroken path of qi, so the hatchet and the user arrive as one.

name: Prismhead
description: The user stands side-on to the wind with the hatchet low and sworn to hold the ground.

name: Intrepid Toss
description: A chop is cut along the cliff's edge, driving the foe toward the drop.

name: Straight Thumbnotch
description: A toss follows a fixed bearing taken before the throw and lands on that line.

name: Spectral Chuck
description: One short step on the oath's count keeps the user on the sworn bearing.

name: Pealbirch
description: The body turns with the gust and the haft sheds a cut at a slant.

name: Lordly Balancepoint
description: A throw runs along the wind's own line across the plateau and lands past the foe's guard.

name: Peal Birchhelve
description: The beard hooks the wrist and a sworn pull draws the arm straight and open.

name: Silken Edgecurve
description: A dash across bare ground ends in a cut with no cover asked or given.

name: Flingbanner
description: Throw, dash and chop make three beats on one sworn bearing.

name: Duneflint
description: Hatchets fan out across the plateau on the gust and scatter a loose group.

name: Seasonpitch
description: The user is carried by a gale-fast flash to the foe's flank and cuts in the same instant.

name: Magnificent Radiance Edgecurve
description: The school's sworn throw: the thrower names a bearing, holds it, and the hatchet goes true along it however the wind pushes.

name: Flintpledge
description: The user fixes a landmark and sets the stance square to it, holding the line.

name: Vigor Lob
description: A chop falls along the held line without wavering, never turned by the opponent's feint.

name: Birchcrown
description: The thrower counts an oath aloud and releases on its last word.

name: Parity Balancepoint
description: The user keeps the bearing while the haft parries and returns to the line.

name: Chuck Grace
description: A step across the wind's direction ends with a cut from the foe's blind side.

name: Matchless Toss
description: A throw sworn at one mark on the foe's body lands on it and nowhere else.

name: Entropy Hurl
description: Axes thrown along a held bearing scatter across the ground ahead and keep it closed to a crossing.

name: Resonant Tomahead
description: Throw and cut follow the sworn bearing in order, each fulfilling the oath of the one before.

name: Pulsarlob
description: The user flashes along the held bearing and strikes where it ends.

name: Dauntless Tailknob
description: The school's finishing cut: a bearing held through every feint of the fight ends in one cut straight down its line.

name: Statute Throwhelve
description: The user stands facing the wind with the hatchet at the shoulder, ready to throw or cut.

name: Quenched Quickbit
description: A broad chop with the whole body behind it lands in open ground where there is room to swing.

name: Inferno Balancepoint
description: A short throw into the wind is kept flat so the gust cannot lift it.

name: Flintvow
description: The haft slips along a blade and lets the wind's push carry it past.

name: Silken Lob
description: A crouched step through long grass hides the user until the throw.

name: Unrivaled Thumbnotch
description: A throw released as a gust rises from behind carries far and bites hard.

name: Spikepoll Pledge
description: The beard tugs a cloak or banner into the wind, blinding and unbalancing its wearer.

name: Season Fling
description: Three throws in a chain, each corrected for wind by the one before, close the gap to a chop.

name: Hailing Lightbit
description: A hail of axes thrown into the wind spreads wide and holds a rank back.

name: Interstice Pitch
description: A flash step from upwind puts the user above the foe and the axe falls with the gust.

name: Noble Thunderclap Birchhelve
description: The school's fall: a throw into the wind is followed by a rush, and the axe comes down with the gust behind it.

name: Headseal
description: The user sets the bit toward the foe and swears not to turn it away.

name: Thunderclap Spikepoll
description: Every chop lands edge-first, the wrist turned so the bit is never flat.

name: Prism Thumbnotch
description: A toss in a stiff gale is made low and hard so the wind's push is brief.

name: Hurlvoyage
description: The user pivots on the lead heel and keeps the bit pointed at the foe's centre.

name: Flintseal
description: The haft is slanted into the gust so a heavy cut meets wood and wind together.

name: Pealchuck
description: A throw sworn on the bit's edge flies bit-forward through any gust.

name: Sigil Tomahead
description: The beard catches a sleeve whipped by the wind and pulls the arm out across the body.

name: Ethereal Fling
description: The user walks straight into a gale with the haft braced, never leaning aside.

name: Lobverdict
description: Chop, throw and chop again keep the bit's edge to the foe throughout.

name: Solar Tailknob
description: Axes thrown edge-first into a gale scatter over open ground and halt a line.

name: Pulsarhead
description: A flash step carries the user through the gale to the foe's side and the bit lands at once.

name: Flintverdict
description: The school's gale finish: sworn to the bit's edge, the user walks into the wind and one cut ends the exchange.

name: Birchtroth
description: The user keeps weight on the balls of the feet as if standing on a moving gust.

name: Haemalhurl
description: A chop is delivered as the user rides a gust forward, adding speed to the fall.

name: Tailknob Banner
description: The axe is thrown along the held bearing while the user rides the wind.

name: Dunehurl
description: A leap timed to a rising gust gives a longer and higher step than muscle alone.

name: Parity Quickbit
description: The haft meets a blow with a yielding turn and rides the force off to the side.

name: Pulsarfling
description: A throw released into a rising gust climbs high and falls steeply onto the target.

name: Sigilhead
description: The beard hooks the foe and the user hauls with the gust, dragging them off balance.

name: Tenethead
description: Throw, ride and chop are chained on the gust so the user is on the foe as the axe lands.

name: Magma Edgecurve
description: Axes loosed on a rising squall fall across a slope or yard in a driving spread.

name: Thunderclap Toss
description: The rider steps into the gale and out of it beside the foe, and the strike lands unseen.

name: Vaunted Pitch Decree
description: The school's descent: the user rides a gust high, throws, and falls after the axe so both land on the same bearing.

name: Steady Balancepoint
description: The user stands open to the whole sky, qi from the Core settled steady in the grip.

name: Famed Lob
description: A chop is driven by Core qi moving like wind through the arm and haft.

name: Unerring Throwhelve
description: Core qi carries the hatchet unerringly along the bearing the user has taken.

name: Sacrosanct Lightbit
description: The haft turns a heavy cut aside with a steadiness the Core's weight provides.

name: Chuck Voyage
description: A step from the Core carries the user across open ground like a gust.

name: Prism Hurl
description: A throw sent along a far bearing keeps its line over a distance beyond ordinary sight.

name: Spikepoll Crown
description: Axes thrown on Core qi spread over a vast open space and hold it against a crossing.

name: Season Chuck
description: Throw, rush and cut share one held bearing, each following the last along the same line.

name: Radiance Birchhelve
description: A flash along the held bearing ends beside the foe and the cut lands in the same breath.

name: Valiant Thumbnotch Decree
description: The doctrine's throw: a bearing taken once holds over any distance, and the hatchet reaches the mark along it.
